name: golf-live-board
description: Live golf scorecard + leaderboard across tee times. No build step: GitHub Pages serves the repo root.

scripts.design:compare: npm run design:compare:dark && npm run design:compare:light
scripts.design:compare:dark: node tests/design-mockups.mjs && FIT_SIZE=393x852 node tests/fit-the-screen.mjs && python3 tests/design-pairs.py
scripts.design:compare:light: MOCK_THEME=light node tests/design-mockups.mjs && FIT_THEME=light FIT_SIZE=393x852 node tests/fit-the-screen.mjs && THEME=light python3 tests/design-pairs.py
